static_traits.name: Lin Jie
static_traits.social_status: Social withdrawal, relationships with colleagues affected; has one work friend to discuss general topics with, but has not discussed the tattoo-related anxiety
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychological counseling or treatment received before; no similar psychological problems related to tattoos in the past

basic_info.main_problem: I worry people will not like me because of my tattoos (specifically six cat tattoos); this belief causes anxiety and social withdrawal.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because anxiety and social withdrawal have markedly affected my daily life and mental health. I just want to feel normal again and not worry all the time.
growth_experiences: After completing the last (sixth) cat tattoo, a colleague at work made a negative comment about tattoos. Since then, Lin Jie has found it hard to shake the feeling that 'others will judge me because of my tattoos'; he began covering his tattoos at work and minimizing interaction with colleagues, and persistent anxiety and social avoidance gradually appeared.

core_beliefs: My tattoos will make others think I am weird or unprofessional

special_situations.event: After a colleague made negative comments about the tattoos at the workplace, situations of continued contact with colleagues
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others see my tattoos, they will think I am strange or unprofessional and thus dislike me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Covers tattoos with clothing at work and reduces communication with colleagues to avoid being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone will look down on me / dislike me because of my tattoos

special_situations.event: At a friend's gathering, socializing with many people, when someone glances at me
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others see my tattoos, they will not be willing to talk with me and will ultimately dislike me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: At a gathering, deliberately covering arms, speaking as little as possible and leaving early
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will not want to talk to me; they are judging me

special_situations.event: In everyday social settings, interacting with strangers or newly met people, the moment of being watched by others
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If someone looks at me, they must be picking on my tattoos or thinking I am unprofessional
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Immediately becoming tense and avoiding eye contact, reducing interaction, changing the topic
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are judging me because of my tattoos

special_situations.event: In social interactions, others remain silent or give no clear evaluation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the other person does not speak, that means they hold a negative view and negate me in their heart
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Further reducing communication and contact to avoid being hurt by 'silent criticism'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Their silence means they think I am not good

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be liked and accepted (including acceptance of the tattoos)
core_conflict.fear: Afraid of being judged and rejected, seen as weird or unprofessional
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being judged by covering tattoos and avoiding socializing
维持安全距离以保护自尊

object_relations.self_representation: 容易被他人评判的脆弱者
object_relations.object_representation: Picky others with negative evaluations (colleagues, social contacts)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests gathering evidence of others' reactions through reality testing, or encourages facing social situations more directly
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worries this will 'confirm' the negative evaluation, and judgments like the colleagues' will happen again
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Expresses concerns in a cautious, tactful tone, emphasizing reasons that it 'might backfire', avoids directly asking others, and chooses safer methods such as recording observations.

manifestations: SingleLiving alone、Social withdrawal
Actively reduces interaction at work and gatherings and covers tattoos to avoid others' contact
Interprets silence as negative evaluation and becomes further distanced from others

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: At gatherings, covers tattoos with clothing to avoid possible judgment
Avoiding directly asking others' opinions about the tattoos
Hiding hurt feelings with a laugh, quickly changing the topic
Reducing interaction at work to avoid others' attention

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Repeatedly doubting how others view the tattoos
Overinterpreting others' gazes and silence as negative signals
Highly vigilant and self-restrained in social situations (covering tattoos, reducing communication)
Worried that reality testing will 'backfire' and does not dare to try

positive_force: Having fondness for and a positive sense of meaning about one's own tattoos
Willing to seek counseling and try reality-testing exercises
Has a work friend who can provide general conversational support
Relatively stable work, with a basic life structure
negative_force: Cognitive distortions such as mind reading, fortune telling, overgeneralization and jumping to conclusions
Social avoidance and covering behaviors reinforce anxiety and isolation
Highly sensitive to others' evaluation, tending to assess self-worth by external recognition
Anxiety interferes with sleep and eating, further harming work performance and interpersonal relationships

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance and marked anxiety triggered by tattoos
antecedent: At work, colleagues or others notice the tattoos
Attending social gatherings or meeting new friends
Seeing others' gazes or the other party's silence
target_behavior.core_reason: After the last tattoo, the client received negative comments from colleagues, forming the belief that 'tattoos will cause others to dislike / judge me', and interprets social cues with catastrophizing and jumping to conclusions
target_behavior.function: Escaping the discomfort of being judged and rejected, protecting self-esteem and safety
target_behavior.consequence: Relationships with colleagues damaged, work performance declined, sleep and eating disrupted, persistent anxiety and further social withdrawal
